biggest_catch: No payment protection or escrow — pay is whatever the poster agrees, negotiated off-board.
catches: No escrow or payment protection — agree on terms and payment before starting work.
Pay is set per posting/negotiation; the board publishes no salary bands.
Posting is free, so some listings are low-effort one-liners — vet each poster.
Competition varies by role; applying does not guarantee a response.

steps: Open jobs.wordpress.net and browse open positions, filtered by category (Development, Support, Plugin Development).
Open postings matching your skills — project and remote-friendly roles are common.
Apply via the employer's stated instructions in the posting.
Negotiate scope, pay, and payment terms directly with the poster before starting work.
timing: Listings post continuously; applications follow each employer's process.
